prompt:
Bug report: with the `toc` extension, a heading like `# Hello world !` gets the id `hello-world-`, with a trailing dash. Fix it and add a regression test.

Work on your own; nobody will answer questions. When you finish, report: status `done` if you did the task, `not_found` if something the task names does not exist, `blocked` if you could not do it; `answer` holds any answer the task asks for (otherwise one short sentence); `changed` lists the files you changed.

report.answer: Fixed: `# Hello world !` with `toc` now gets the id `hello-world`. `slugify` in `markdown/extensions/toc.py` now strips surrounding whitespace before joining with the separator, so a leading stripped character (`# ! Hello world`) no longer leaves a leading dash either, and `slugify_unicode` gets the same fix. I added three regression tests to `tests/test_syntax/extensions/test_toc.py`; they fail without the fix, and the full suite passes with it (1132 tests, 112 skipped). I also added an Unreleased "Fixed" entry to `docs/changelog.md`. Nothing is committed.
